interval_convention: Half-open [effective_from, effective_to); a null effective_to means no known end.
coverage_note: Pilot covers Articles 21A and 45 across the commencement of the Constitution (Eighty-sixth Amendment) Act, 2002. It does not assert a complete constitutional history outside these intervals.

records.verification_notes: The null text represents the not-in-force state, not missing wording. The local original Constitution scan was visually checked at PDF p. 29 (printed p. 12), where Article 21 is followed by Article 22; Article 394 at PDF p. 250 supports the 1950-01-26 commencement. The 86th Amendment Act section 2 at local PDF p. 1 inserts new Article 21A, and official India Code PDF text-view evidence identifies 2010-04-01 as the appointed date (PDF p. 1, printed folio (1); not visually inspected locally). A complete check for any earlier Article 21A operation across the full 1950–2010 amendment history is still absent, so continuous evidence coverage is not established and this record remains partially_verified.

records.text: 21A. The State shall provide free and compulsory education to all children of the age of six to fourteen years in such manner as the State may, by law, determine.

source_reference.source_document: Constitution (Eighty-sixth Amendment) Act, 2002; local primary-source PDF raw/amendments/086_Amendment_2002.pdf; official Legislative Department PDF https://www.legislative.gov.in/static/uploads/2025/07/16970eb1a68d4fe46ac40acd783a6c34.pdf
source_reference.page_or_locator: Local PDF p. 1, section 2, 'Insertion of new article 21A'; exact operative wording retained, excluding the Act's enclosing quotation marks and terminal amendment punctuation.

commencement_evidence.page_or_locator: Notification dated 2010-02-16; Gazette publication 2010-02-19; official PDF p. 1 (printed folio (1)) text-view appoints 2010-04-01. The page image was not visually inspected locally; no local PDF hash is available.

records.verification_notes: The exact operative wording is supported by section 2 of the local 86th Amendment Act PDF, p. 1, and matches Article 21A in the official consolidated Constitution snapshot dated 2026-05-01, PDF p. 42. Official India Code PDF text-view evidence for S.O. 427(E), PDF p. 1, supports the commencement date 2010-04-01; the page image was not visually inspected locally and no local PDF hash is available. The consolidated snapshot establishes Article 21A's text on its as-of date but does not establish uninterrupted validity for every date since 2010. A complete post-insertion amendment-history check is still absent, so no continuous evidence_coverage is recorded and this record remains partially_verified.
